lead: The published gate report (bc-corridors-85, 2026-09-12) is retained below as the coordinated baseline; the sections above it are measured on the current model on every refresh. Nothing here qualifies structure, slabs, vehicles or traffic.

basis.method: Continuous sweep bounded by adaptive poses and added allowance; oriented component envelopes. Full assembled geometry is screened regardless of display filters. No dynamic stability, braking, slab capacity or operating approval.

routes.label: Plant perimeter logistics circuit
routes.note: Proposed receiving/dispatch circulation outside process bays and remote retention tanks. Requires site-boundary and new slab qualification; it is not an existing approved roadway.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope

trafficControl.requirement: Confirm the site traffic plan, crossings and actual truck/load before use.

routes.label: A-100 / A-140 / A-160 delivery frontage
routes.note: Frontage staging only. Individual unloading interfaces and pedestrian crossings require an operating plan.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope

trafficControl.requirement: Preview assumes pedestrian access is closed and the engineer animation is stopped. Real use requires a separated pedestrian route where practicable, or an engineered closure/control arrangement under WorkSafeBC 16.6. This preview does not operate physical gates.

routes.label: A-5000 east service approach
routes.note: Connects west delivery frontage to the north logistics corridor. Controlled reversing at delivery stops; no lifting beneath utilities.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope

trafficControl.requirement: Confirm the site traffic plan, crossings and actual truck/load before use.

routes.label: A-6000 approach → right turn → service aisle
routes.note: Approach north on the west frontage, turn right into the cross-aisle, continue east and stop before the distribution risers. The turn starts at X32 / Z39.5 and ends at X35.5 / Z36 with the 3.5 m planning radius. This is a forklift route; bulk supplier unloading and the return manoeuvre are separate studies.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope

trafficControl.requirement: Confirm the site traffic plan, crossings and actual truck/load before use.

routes.label: A-300 → A-1000 under-rack aisle
routes.note: Approach from the open space east of A-300, turn right and continue beneath the shared services along the A-1000 frontage. Stop at X52 / Z2.6. The entrance is offset from the existing wash-service columns and low filtration piping. The complete truck/load envelope is reserved before rack placement; pipe endpoints, gravity slopes and equipment legs remain fixed. One-way access preview; loading and return movements remain unqualified.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope

trafficControl.requirement: Confirm the site traffic plan, crossings and actual truck/load before use.

routes.label: Receiving → A-100 delivery frontage
routes.note: Proposed receiving transfer via the reserved west corridor to raw-material staging. Stops at the frontage; dock interfaces, unloading and the return manoeuvre are not modeled.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope

trafficControl.requirement: Preview assumes pedestrian access is closed and the engineer animation is stopped. Real use requires a separated pedestrian route where practicable, or an engineered closure/control arrangement under WorkSafeBC 16.6. This preview does not operate physical gates.

routes.label: A-800 east frontage → north dispatch
routes.note: Proposed outward transfer along the reserved east and north perimeter. Starts outside A-800; equipment pickup, dispatch bays, site boundary and slab capacity still require confirmation.
routes.status: No modeled obstruction in screened envelope
